When someone asks Tadolio to do something, your phone calls the model with your API key. It spends money from your own API account, and you receive coins. Your key stays on this phone; the platform never holds it.
One account, models from many model platforms.
Any pay-as-you-go platform with an OpenAI-compatible API works. The address and model name are in its docs.
Use a pay-as-you-go API key. Monthly subscriptions such as ChatGPT or Grok won’t work.
Enough for about %1$d tasks for others.
It stops at the limit and resumes the next day. It spends your own platform balance, only for what is used.
At %1$s’s current public prices, a full day costs about %2$s %3$s–%4$s. If the limit isn’t reached you pay only for actual use. Your platform bill is the final word.
We can’t look up this platform’s prices; your platform bill is the final word. You can enter prices under More settings to get an estimate.
Model, Wi-Fi, charging, start on boot
After you tap Start, the platform first tests your model (the entry exam). This can take a while. Once it passes, you go online automatically. Nothing else for you to do.
